intended_object: Proof-internal data for the word-reduction step of the combinatorial classification of surfaces. It records that a token list is, up to cyclic rotation, laid out as: a residual dart of edge `outer`, then a completed handle block on edges `first` and `second`, then some inner tokens, then the inverse residual dart of `outer`, then some outer tokens. It also records that the three edges are distinct and do not occur in the surrounding tokens. The docstring says "a completed handle at the head of a protected residual-pair interval"; the name and its use show this.
explanation: This structure is a bookkeeping device in the library's normal-form algorithm for surface words. It packages a cyclic decomposition of a list of `ReductionToken`s together with the side conditions needed to apply a "commute the handle block past the pair" move. It is defined, and its lemmas are proved, in the same file (FiniteCyclicWordReduction.lean, around lines 2157–2263 and 2756–2792), and it is built at lines 3466 and 3600 as an intermediate step of the reduction. The literature has no standard object it is meant to formalize. It is an implementation detail of the proof (a case of the cut-and-paste handle normalization), so it cannot be judged as faithful to, or more general than, any standard notion.
